scores.reason: Label propagation method focused on uncertainty estimation, not a training-recipe ablation on CIFAR.

Proposes Forward-Forward (layer-local) training algorithm as alternative to backprop. Not a recipe change applied to standard supervised training; architectural/algorithmic change, not recipe component.
Review of generative models (VAE, GAN, flows). Not about discriminative CIFAR training or recipe components.
Forward-mode gradient method to avoid backprop. Different training algorithm, not a recipe-component change.
Multi-label learning framework using iterated teacher-student. Not a recipe ablation; changes learning paradigm, not recipe components.
Pretrained model adaptation excluded: paper assumes pre-trained source model (violates 'no pretrained weights').
Inserts learnable prototypes and quadratic consensus penalty at intermediate layer during training. Adds forward passes through the lifted network; violates 'no extra forward/backward passes.'
Active learning sample selection under label noise. Not a recipe-component change; focuses on which samples to select, not how to train.
Adversarial robustness via diffusion-based denoising. Not a training recipe change for standard accuracy on CIFAR.
Adds wavelet denoising, quantization, and shift detection during adversarial training. Adds computational overhead; not a recipe-only change.
Implicit ensemble method (explicitly excluded). Proposes diversity modulation via sigmoid scalers and softmax-temperature regularization across multiple members.
Adversarial training method (excluded): generating adversarial examples adds forward/backward passes and extra compute.
Normalization and effective learning rates in RL, not supervised CIFAR training from scratch. Domain mismatch: RL setting, not CIFAR-10/100.
Adversarial training method (excluded). Addresses robustness-accuracy trade-off in adversarial training, not standard CIFAR recipe ablation.
Fast adversarial training method (excluded). Proposes adaptive similarity step size to prevent catastrophic overfitting in single-step adversarial training.
Bayesian inference with Langevin dynamics. Not supervised classification on CIFAR from scratch; focuses on scaling MCMC inference.
Federated adversarial training (excluded). Combines federated learning with adversarial training; both add communication/compute overhead or fall under exclusions.
Learning rate schedule optimization is a relevant recipe component. However, abstract does not clearly report controlled CIFAR-10/100 ablations at ≤15 epochs with numerical deltas.
Learning rate schedule design under scaling-law theory is topically relevant (recipe component). No clear evidence of CIFAR-10/100 short-budget (≤15 epoch) results in excerpt.
Learning rate schedule for continual self-supervised pre-training, not supervised CIFAR training from scratch. Domain: continual SSL, not target domain.
